g.text: 1. Insert 10 mm bottom-panel dowels into motherboard tray sockets.

text.descriptionVerbose: Enriched SVG element or container of type 'unknown'.
text.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

g.text: 2. Slide motherboard tray forward until dowels fully seat.

text.descriptionVerbose: Enriched SVG element or container of type 'unknown'.
text.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

g.text: 3. Install ATX standoffs in labeled ATX/mATX/ITX hole pattern.

text.descriptionVerbose: Enriched SVG element or container of type 'unknown'.
text.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

g.text: 4. Mount motherboard and tighten screws evenly.

text.descriptionVerbose: Enriched SVG element or container of type 'unknown'.
text.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

g.text: 5. Align PSU tray dowel sockets with bottom panel dowels.

text.descriptionVerbose: Enriched SVG element or container of type 'unknown'.
text.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

g.text: 6. Slide PSU tray downward until fully locked.

text.descriptionVerbose: Enriched SVG element or container of type 'unknown'.
text.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

g.text: 7. Install PSU screws using 81.5 × 71.5 mm pattern.

text.descriptionVerbose: Enriched SVG element or container of type 'unknown'.
text.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

g.text: 8. Connect motherboard 24-pin, CPU 8-pin, GPU power as needed.

text.descriptionVerbose: Enriched SVG element or container of type 'unknown'.
text.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

g.text: 9. Install Raspberry Pi 5 on its 58×48 mm mount if used.

text.descriptionVerbose: Enriched SVG element or container of type 'unknown'.
text.notes: All attributes and structure preserved exactly from original SVG; enrichment adds documentation fields only.

g.text: 10. Ensure CPU cooler fits within service cutout area.
